results.caption:
Kuch bhiiiiiiii 😱

“Natural” doesn’t always mean it’s meant for everything. 👀

I’ve seen this viral claim that vag  discharge can be used as a natural moisturiser. Here’s why that’s not a good idea.

✨ Vag discharge has an important job:
✔️ Keeps the vagina healthy
✔️ Maintains the right pH
✔️ Protects against infections

❌ But it’s not designed to moisturise your face, lips, or skin. It contains bacteria (including healthy vaginal bacteria), proteins, enzymes, and cellular debris that belong in the vaginal environment—not on other parts of your body.

If your skin is dry, use products that are actually formulated and tested for skin. And if your vaginal discharge suddenly changes in colour, smell, or is associated with itching or burning, that’s a reason to see your gynaecologist—not a skincare hack.

🚨 Don’t believe every “natural beauty” trend you see online.

💬 Have you come across this viral advice? Tell me in the comments.

❤️ Save this reel to avoid falling for health misinformation and share it with someone who needs to hear this.

results.transcript: It's time to talk about hypochlorous acid spray again, because the internet has people convinced that they need some sort of special container and some magical formula that's worth $100 when that's not the case, and I'm telling you this as a cosmetic chemist. Now, hypochlorous acid spray is having a major moment right now, but that's actually a good thing in my opinion. It's gentle, versatile, and one of the few things that your body actually makes naturally that you can find in skincare, so it's really cool as a biologist. Specialized white blood cells called neutrophils actually produce it as part of your innate immune system. It's one of the natural compounds that our body actually uses to fight off pathogens and help with wound healing. Yes, I will admit the hypochlorous acid can be unstable in certain formulations or environments, but the modern world and the modern skincare industry has mostly overcome that. And they've overcome that while still maintaining the ability to actually provide very efficacious and affordable formulas like this one from Pacifica that is $12, so yeah, you don't need to break the bank, and I've been testing this for a whole month to see if it actually works. And there is this myth that hypochlorous acid spray needs to be in some expensive bottle to work, but that's just not true from a chemistry standpoint. A standard spray bottle is actually totally fine. Its stability really is much more dependent on things like pH, concentration, purity of the water, and the conditions you've stored in, such as avoiding heat and light. Now, most skincare products use a concentration of about 0.01 to 0.02% and stored in a type of water that is usually pH balanced to maintain relative stability. The ingredient list on this product from Pacifica is refreshingly simple. It is water, hypochlorous acid, and sodium chloride, so literally three ingredients. And no, the sodium chloride is not a filler ingredient, like I've seen many people say. It is actually part of the electrochemical process that is going to help stabilize and produce hypochlorous acid. It does this by actually helping maintain the ionic balance. An expensive product doesn't automatically mean a better one, and a longer ingredient list doesn't necessarily mean a more effective ingredient list. My favorite way to use this is actually after workouts. I'm a runner, and I've especially started running now that it's warmer here in the Northeast, and that also means that I'm more likely to sweat and sometimes develop body or truncal acne. And I definitely really enjoy this for helping with those body breakouts, and it's something that has really been able to help with my skin and those breakout areas. And one thing I especially like about this formula is it carries the National Psoriasis Foundation Seal of Rec- ignition, which is really hard to get. As someone who worked in the skincare industry, I know that getting those things on formulas is a lot of testing, a lot of investment, time, and money, so I really think it's cool as they went the extra mile for this as well. And what I'll leave you with is you can get an amazing, efficacious, hypochlorous acid spray at an affordable price, and not have to worry about things like stability or anything else, because the science is sound in how these work and how these are stabilized.
